_comment: DEMO post templates. Invented content shown with a DEMO label — never real announcements. build-places.ts assigns them to real OSM places by venue group (deterministically). Times are relative: start = HH:MM on 'today' + dayOffset; validDays for offers; postedHoursAgo for freshness. No real performers, brands or prices of real businesses.
